caveat: A 60-tree stand-in for the production 300-tree forest, not the forest itself. It reproduces the console's figure within the fidelity figures below.

target.name: typical closing price of the plate
target.formula: log_price = mean over trees of the leaf value reached by walking the feature vector
target.output: price = the nearest 500 SAR step to exp(log_price), clamped into the likely range
target.band_rule: likely range = exp(log_price +/- bands[market][digits].likely_log); wide range = same with .wide_log; both edges snap inward to the 500 SAR grid

input.number: 1-4 digit characters; leading zeros stripped; a value of 0 is not a plate
input.letters: 1-3 Latin letters from ABDEGHJKLNRSTUVXZ; Arabic letters map through arabic_to_latin

feature_notes.letter_identity_columns: excluded on purpose (the production model does not read them)
feature_notes.unknown_tier_or_type: every tier_/ptype_ column is 0; never a guessed value
feature_notes.letters_ascending: true only when the letters are unique and in alphabetical order
feature_notes.spells_known_word: 1 when the letter string is in word_letters

fidelity_to_production_model.sample: 30000 random plates, balanced across 1/2/3/4-digit values, 18 letter shapes, both markets, tier and plate type including unknown
